decision: Do not export or deploy either identity head. Paired consistency modestly improves average synthetic error and print invariance, but real sparse training error worsens and visual review finds the same major real-photo failures. The existing production body fallback and colour classifier remain unchanged.

matchedExperiment.qualification: Initial saved raw probabilities are not bitwise equal across the two training processes; preserve the failed exact check below. Initial weights, data, draws and threshold metrics are exact. No replicated training seeds or isolated bitwise-deterministic causal claim.

realTraining.scope: Partial known regions only. Unlabelled material is excluded from joint class scoring but remains in the separate body score. Missing body counts as a material joint error. Fractional labels score expected hard-classification disagreement. No complete-boundary, crop or cutting-template accuracy claim.

freshSameProcessReplay.scope: Fresh inference with both fixed checkpoints and their exact common parent in one process; all weights and image inputs unchanged. No retraining or source edits.

numericalChecks.interpretation: Both checkpoint bodies are exactly equal in fresh same-process inference, and all 32 native-probe bodies exactly match the prior reference. Saved training fields differ by at most 1.1920928955078125e-7, with no changed half-threshold pixels. This is consistent with cross-process floating-point variation; the specific kernel cause is not established. The original exact-field failure is retained, not converted to a tolerance pass.
numericalChecks.rendererCorrection: The renderer records raw equality failures and displays each model using its own actual body. It verifies matched weights, inputs, draws and source/probe identity. No training, target, threshold or checkpoint was changed.

visualReview.scope: Qualitative inspection of every fixed real training and development image, plus the retained largest-error synthetic galleries. Development photos have already been inspected in prior experiments. No independently labelled complete artwork or cutting-path comparison.

training.observation: First four real training photos: printed flowers/stripes remain false paper changes; low-contrast red/pink loses major checker regions. Both arms look similar.
Next four training photos: gold/blue body omissions persist; sloth and bicycle remain recognizable with noisy or rounded details. Both arms look similar.
Four checker/curved-checker photos: both round corners and join or erase narrow transitions. A false tiny island remains in the outdoor checker.

Last four training photos: surrounding ornament leaks through the frozen body; swallow is recognizable; paired training removes a small false mark in the handheld red/green checker, while shadowed purple/white openings remain distorted.

visualReview.synthetic: All four largest-error pages inspected. Printed stars, flowers and stripes remain false material regions. One crowded central-heart scene regresses from about 22.46% to 32.56% despite a lower scene average. Individual large gains do not make the worst examples usable.
visualReview.reasonNoRecoveryCount: No downstream fitting or exact real design ground truth in this experiment; do not convert visual impressions into a success rate.

rootCauseEvidence: Severe errors occur in full-photo body/material fields before crop estimation or fitting. Cropping alone cannot explain these failures.
Printed ink is still frequently mistaken for the identity of the paper beneath it. Explicit paired consistency reduces, but does not remove, this behaviour on these synthetic training views.
Missing dark or reflective paper and included hands/handles are separate frozen-body limitations; identity training cannot change that frozen output.

Small openings, rounded checker corners and narrow branches remain wrong on plain paper too. The earlier free-grid diagnostic rules out output-grid capacity as a complete explanation on its 32 synthetic labels only.
Single-seed, small-data results do not isolate architecture, training diversity and sparse-label coverage as causal factors; those remain hypotheses.

validation.applicationCheckScope: Offline Python tooling and research records only. Deployed PR17 remains covered by its recorded complete application/inverse suite and 11 live browser checks.

nextStep: Inspect existing palette, ROI and context/detail experiments before designing a paper-exemplar-conditioned classifier. Test whether identifying each sheet from exposed lobe texture supplies information missing from local colour prediction, with fixed crops and all failures retained. This is a research hypothesis, not a promised solution.
